//: This file exists so the deploy configuration lives in the repo rather than
in Vercel's dashboard, where it can drift silently. The project was first
imported when this repo was plain HTML, so its stored preset is whatever
was detected then — not Next.js. Values set here override the dashboard.
null means 'use the framework's own default', which is also an override:
it discards a stale Build Command or Output Directory left from the static
site. Next resolves its own output, so do not name a directory here.
